_comment: Deterministic key-roll state pinning the three crypto-floor migration stages. Fixed seeds give reproducible CI-stable bytes; never used in production.

stages.notes: v3.18 bundle accepted byte-identically; PQ key not provisioned.
Hybrid key composed from same Ed25519 + initial ML-DSA-65; classical bundles still accepted (allows_classical_only=true).
PQ key rolled to a fresh ML-DSA-65 seed before stage 3; classical bundles rejected (threat_id=pq_signature_downgrade).
